meta.name: understand-knowledge
meta.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LLM知识库转化为交互式知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从大量文本中提取实体和关系并可视化
copy.tagline_en: Transform LLM knowledge base into interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relationships from large text and visualize them

howto.what: 当提供符合 Karpathy 模式的 wiki 目录（含 index.md 和多篇含 wiki 链接的 .md 文件）时，Claude 会自动分析并生成交互式知识图谱，展示实体、关系、主题聚类，并打开仪表盘。
howto.when: 当你给出一个 wiki 目录路径，或者你正处于这样的目录中，并且该目录包含 index.md 和多个带 [[链接]] 的 .md 文件时触发。

say.text: 分析当前文件夹下的 Karpathy 风格 wiki。
say.note: Claude 开始检测并生成知识图谱。

say.text: 对 ~/projects/llm-wiki 运行知识图谱生成。

howto.what_en: Given a Karpathy-pattern wiki directory (with index.md and multiple .md files containing wikilinks), Claude automatically analyzes it, extracts entities and relationships, clusters topics, and generates an interactive knowledge graph dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a wiki directory path or are in such a directory, and it contains index.md plus .md files with [[wikilinks]].

say_en.text: Analyze the Karpathy-style wiki in the current folder.
say_en.note: Claude detects and builds the knowledge graph.
